entries.name: unfuelled-forge
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied 224×224 transparent Settlement forge icon. Remove ONLY the burning orange flames, all glowing embers and charcoal pieces from the brick hearth: this is the same UNFUELLED forge before charcoal is added. The empty hearth interior should be dark brick/stone. Preserve the exact isometric viewpoint, red-orange rough brick construction, golden brown bellows on the right, charcoal-grey anvil in the front right, dimensions, silhouette, strong black ink outlines, rustic coloured woodcut cuts and handmade flat colour texture. Transparent background; no text, labels, extra objects, scenery or shadow ground. The whole object must remain uncropped and centred with a narrow clear margin.

entries.name: stove-base
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied Settlement stove icon. This is the SAME stove before its cooking pot has been inserted. Remove the little round lid AND its inset cooking vessel from the stove top, leaving one simple open round black hole edged by the iron stove plate. Keep EVERYTHING ELSE unchanged: red-orange brick body, iron top plate perspective, orange fire burning in front opening, brick sill and feet, black contour cuts, rustic coloured woodcut treatment and existing isometric camera. No pot or lid anywhere in this image. Same square canvas and object framing, entire stove uncropped with transparent surrounding margin. Transparent background, no text, no floor, no new objects.

entries.name: stove-pot
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target supplied transparent open-top brick stove. Create ONLY the fitted cooking pot sprite for this exact stove, on the SAME square canvas. Remove the entire stove and retain transparent background everywhere except the pot. The pot is a simple hammered black iron vessel with a broad rolled circular rim that fits the stove's oval opening. It sits down into the opening so only a short dark metal upper lip, its snug grey-black iron lid with one small knob, and two small side lifting lugs are visible above the iron plate. Preserve the stove's viewing angle: the opening ellipse is centred roughly x=51%, y=24% of the canvas, about 39% of canvas width and 15% of canvas height. The fitted pot should occupy that same place and scale, not be centred on the canvas. No stove or bricks, no flame or hearth, no ground, no labels or extra objects. Match rough black-outlined rustic coloured woodcut with charcoal grey metal and pale cut highlights. True transparency; ample transparent space below is intentional registration padding.

entries.name: cooking-pot
entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate the complete loose COOKING POT that matches the supplied fitted pot sprite. The reference shows only its broad rolled rim, lid, and small side lifting lugs when it is inset into a brick stove. Now show the whole removable vessel: a practical deep, squat, cylindrical hammered black iron cooking pot, grey-black iron lid with the same small knob, same two small curled iron side lifting lugs. Its lower bowl narrows slightly to a flat bottom, no legs, no arched swinging handle. It should clearly be iron, with dark charcoal body and sparse cool grey tool-mark highlights, NOT brown pottery and NOT enamel. Single complete object isolated and centred, modest three-quarter elevated view matching reference. Rustic coloured woodcut: strong black ink shapes, irregular carved cut marks, restrained flat grey metal colour. Entire pot uncropped with narrow transparent margin. True transparent background, no stove, no fire, no ingredients, no paper, no diagram, no text.
